about_short_description.short_description: ChatFood offers e-commerce, chatbots, and online ordering services for restaurants.

product.name: Commission-free Online Ordering Platform
product.description: A platform that enables restaurants and hospitality venues to accept online orders without paying commission fees.

product.name: NFC/QR Ordering System
product.description: A system that uses NFC and QR codes to enable customers to place orders directly from their mobile devices at hospitality venues.

product.name: Multi-Channel Ordering Integration
product.description: Integration of ordering capabilities across multiple digital channels including websites, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and Google.

product.name: Pre-Ordering System
product.description: A system that allows customers to place orders in advance for later pickup or delivery.

product.name: Advanced Analytics
product.description: Analytics tools that provide insights into sales, customer behavior, and operational performance for hospitality venues.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A service that enables hospitality businesses to send payment requests to customers via links for easy and direct payment processing.
